open_design_and_runtime_gaps.item: Windows/OneDrive/Google Drive sync and restore not empirically tested
Independently verifiable chain anchors and signatures not established
Independent user retention/privacy/legal review not performed
Real post-deployment SLO and effect windows not measured
PeerHub/Engram/MCP live integration under actual installation not verified

notes: R3 closes feedback loop as a design contract, not as a deployed working system.
R2 evidence schema v2 remains authoritative; governance schema v1 is separate.
Static schema fixtures prove only a structural subset of contract validity.
Root-cause review and operational effect measurement must be performed after TDD.
